name: European Commission · CSDDD
use: Track HRDD duties, amendments, applicability dates and scope; relevant to regulatory impact and governance studies.

name: EU Forced Labour Regulation
use: Track forced-labour product restrictions, enforcement arrangements and corporate risk exposure, separating applicability from enforcement outcomes.

name: EUR-Lex · EU Legal Documents
use: Check legal provisions, consolidated versions, amendments, announcements and national transposition; primary basis for institutional variables.

name: International Labour Organization (ILO)
use: Forced-labour definitions, fundamental labour standards, OSH, trade-union rights and labour statistics.

name: Business & Human Rights Resource Centre
use: Corporate human rights allegations, company responses and cross-border supply chain case leads; corroborate against primary reporting.

name: OECD · Responsible Business Conduct
use: Due diligence guidance, supply chain governance, stakeholder engagement and remediation.

name: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI)
use: European labour policy, collective bargaining, OSH and labour research; complement company disclosures with workers' perspectives.

name: International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC)
use: Global labour rights, freedom of association and collective bargaining, supporting outcome and institutional comparisons.

name: ETH Zurich · Supply Chain Management Group
use: Follow research in supply chain management, network governance and social sustainability; this site is independent of ETH.

name: Crossref · Scholarly Metadata
use: Discover recent scholarly publications, DOIs, titles and dates. Publication quality and designs require manual review.

name: Google News · Topic Monitoring
use: Query-based discovery of potential leads. Aggregated results are not primary evidence; trace the original publisher.

name: Eurostat · Official European Statistics
use: Supply-chain sectors, trade, labour markets and official statistics for defining populations and covariates in policy evaluation.

name: German Federal Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs (BMAS) · Supply Chain Due Diligence Act
use: Official German LkSG requirements and institutional enforcement framework; distinguish applicable law from press summaries.

name: OECD · National Contact Points Case Database
use: Non-judicial grievance cases, alleged breaches and reported outcomes; case selection and reporting biases must be considered.

name: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA)
use: Occupational health and safety evidence, survey data and risks relevant to worker outcomes in European value chains.

name: World Benchmarking Alliance · Corporate Human Rights Benchmark
use: Comparative company HRDD and remedy indicators; scores are methodology-dependent proxies, not confirmed violations.

name: KnowTheChain · Forced Labour Benchmarks
use: Sector benchmarks on corporate action against forced-labour risks in supply chains; assess coverage and scoring limitations.
